LanguageData.RWU_SpareEnemyMarkDesc: Toggle the spare mark. Player-controlled colonists will not select this hostile pawn as an attack target, and damage caused by them will be blocked.
LanguageData.RWU_SpareEnemyUnmarkDesc: Remove the spare mark. Player-controlled colonists may attack this hostile pawn again.
LanguageData.RWU_SpareEnemyUnmarkCorpseDesc: Remove the persistent spare mark from this corpse.
